cards.card_text: This man is blaspheming This man must be a prophet This man should heal him first
cards.verse_text: On seeing this, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man is blaspheming!”
cards.snippet: …seeing this, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man is blaspheming!”

cards.card_text: He is blaspheming since only God can forgive sins He should not be teaching on the Sabbath He should have healed the man before anything else
